findings.passage: It is common sense that we provide regulation to deadly weapons, as we regulate automobiles and drivers. I support raising the age to purchase guns, requiring enhanced background checks for all purchases, limiting the sale of high-capacity magazines, and requiring gun owners to secure their weapons. Gun violence has become a public health crisis, as a public health scientist I am uniquely qualified to find and implement changes to protect Georgia’s schools and Georgia’s children.
findings.note: Her answer to the 2022 voter-guide question on what restrictions on gun ownership are needed (she was then a candidate for the Georgia House). The page is tied to the November 8, 2022 general election; the answer itself carries no separate date.
